subject: Malaysia M-510 TiO2 for RD water-based coatings
body:
RD-Metal Unicoat is a water-based acrylic direct-to-metal coating, and RD's laboratory works with pigments, resins and additives.

We manufacture Malaysia-origin M-510 rutile TiO2. Its TDS lists wall latex paints and zirconium/aluminium treatment; suitability for your protective coatings would need formulation assessment.

May I send you the M-510 technical sheet for your purchasing and laboratory review?
